title: WP Admin Shell — tokens.json (DTCG 2025.10)
description: Minimal local schema for the DTCG primitives layer the WP Admin Shell consumes (W3C Design Tokens Community Group editor's draft, 2025.10). The full DTCG spec governs token authoring; this schema is a compatible subset that validates the structural invariants the shell's resolver relies on. When the upstream DTCG schema stabilizes, this file may be retired in favor of the canonical `$ref`. See spec §9 of `docs/wp-admin-shell-design-spec.md` for context.
